def best_iou(s,t):
    best=0
    for di in range(-4,5):
        for dj in range(-4,5):
            H=max(s.shape[0],t.shape[0]+abs(di))+2; W=max(s.shape[1],t.shape[1]+abs(dj))+2
            a=np.zeros((H,W),bool); b=np.zeros((H,W),bool)
            a[1:1+s.shape[0],1:1+s.shape[1]]=s.astype(bool)
            i0=1+di; j0=1+dj
            if i0<0 or j0<0: continue
            b[i0:i0+t.shape[0],j0:j0+t.shape[1]]=t.astype(bool)
            inter=(a&b).sum(); union=(a|b).sum()
            best=max(best,inter/union)
    return best
def medoid(shapes):
    n=len(shapes)
    scores=[]
    for i in range(n):
        scores.append(sum(best_iou(shapes[i],shapes[j]) for j in range(n) if j!=i))
    return scores
